name: Khazanchi Jewellers Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1996, Khazanchi Jewellers 
Ltd is in the business of buying and selling 
of Gold ornaments, Gold bullion and Silver bullion[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) KJL specializes in a wide array of jewelry products and offers a range that includes gold, diamonds, and precious stones, and exquisite fancy jewelry. It also offers bullion items like coins and bars. 
b) It deals in wholesale and retail market. 
c) Currently, the company has ~25+ Products Category, ~5 Lakh+ Design Library, ~1,200 sq. ft. Retail Showroom

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 81.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 62.3 days to 47.6 days
cons: Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
